items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Emile introduced me to my wife.

ctx.x: I mean, he's been dead a while. Well, that's an old faculty telling me. Yeah.

Well, that's about all the roughness I know around there, because they had the pimps and all that around there, you know. But they didn't hang out with Frank Torres. See, Frank Torres would invite the show from the Burlesque, Rose, who ran the, who was that running, Ryan? Huh? What's that, is that, was the Burlesque, what's that? Dolphin Theatre. Huh? Dolphin Theatre. Dolphin Theatre. Yeah. Blue Rose run it, see. Mm-hm. And I was up in Birmingham working for Gus Wick. He had married this girl in blue that had…
Was she from, from here? Well, Mamie didn't know.
